name: git-stage-hunk
description: Non-interactive hunk staging for selective git add without TTY. Stage only part of a file, specific hunks, or pattern-matched changes when git add -p is unavailable.

interface.shortDescription: Stage selected git hunks without a TTY
interface.longDescription: Lists unstaged hunks with stable IDs and stages only the ones you pick, by ID, sub-hunk, line range, file, or regex, so a commit holds just this session's changes.
defaultPrompt: Use $git-stage-hunk to list the unstaged hunks in this repository.
Use $git-stage-hunk to stage only the hunks I changed in this session.
Use $git-stage-hunk to show what is staged versus unstaged.
